# AI Architect Mastery (AAM)

> AI Architect Mastery publishes the AI Driven Development Methodology: a human-led, vendor-neutral method for engineering software with AI agents. Humans own intent, scope and decisions; agents perform bounded work through PRD → PLAN → TASK → IMPLEMENTATION. Review and evidence do not automatically authorize release.

This is a supplementary directory of public references, not an access policy or a promise of search inclusion. The HTML pages are the public content reference.

## Methodology

- [Methodology overview](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/methodology/): Definition, human responsibility and the four-phase workflow.
- [PRD](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/methodology/prd.html): Intent, scope, constraints and acceptance criteria.
- [PLAN](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/methodology/plan.html): A reviewed, dependency-aware implementation approach.
- [TASK](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/methodology/task.html): Bounded delegation with context and expected evidence.
- [IMPLEMENTATION](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/methodology/implementation.html): Execution, verification and a human decision.

The methodology pages are reference-only: no course enrollment is required.

## AAM Agent Workflow, Free Resources and Courses

- [AAM Agent Workflow](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/agent-workflow/): A free template repository for the AI Driven Development Methodology (PRD, PLAN, TASK, IMPLEMENTATION), delivered as plain Markdown files: templates for the PRD, PLAN and TASK, an IMPLEMENTATION review checklist and reusable prompts. The current release is BETA 2.0.0. The email signup on that page takes you to the repository and starts a three-day onboarding guide. It is not an agent or an installer, and nothing runs on its own.
- [Free Resources](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/free-resources/): Prompts and templates from the AAM videos, sent free by email. The first resource is the AAM Prompt Pack: every prompt in the AAM Agent Workflow, currently the agent guidance review prompts (review the Copilot instructions, custom agents and prompt files a project already has, one approved change at a time) and the fresh session handoff prompts. The pack follows the AAM Agent Workflow releases. The prompts do not enforce tool permissions or guarantee performance gains.
- [AAM email list](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/#contact): The homepage form joins the AAM email list: founding price news for Mastering AI Driven Development and practical insights on the AI Driven Development Methodology. A free resource is sent only if it is ticked in the form.
- [Courses](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/courses/): AI Architect Mastery courses for experienced developers: GitHub Copilot certification (GH-300) preparation now, and Mastering AI Driven Development coming soon. Check the linked provider for current availability and pricing; Mastering AI Driven Development is not available for enrollment yet.

## GH-300 Certification Documentation

- [GH-300 hub](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/gh-300/): Six free written study guides, organized around the official skills outline of August 7, 2026 and updated November 2026. These pages are not six separately available courses.
- [Responsible AI](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/gh-300/responsible-ai.html): Responsible AI principles and limitations.
- [Copilot features](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/gh-300/copilot-features.html): Copilot interfaces and capabilities.
- [Data and architecture](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/gh-300/data-and-architecture.html): Context, data flow and model limitations.
- [Prompt engineering](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/gh-300/prompt-engineering.html): Prompt structure and context.
- [Developer productivity](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/gh-300/developer-productivity.html): Development use cases and their limits.
- [Privacy and safeguards](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/gh-300/privacy-and-safeguards.html): Privacy settings and safeguards.
- [Official GH-300 study guide](https://aka.ms/GH300-StudyGuide): Provider reference for current exam objectives; each domain guide also links its technical sources.

## About

- [Ari Vilkman — AI Architect](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/about/): Ari Vilkman is an AI Architect and the founder of AI Architect Mastery and Data Integration Mastery; he created the AI Driven Development Methodology (PRD → PLAN → TASK → IMPLEMENTATION).
- [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@AIArchitectMastery): AAM videos supporting the written references.
